Package dev.galasa.zosbatch.spi

Class ZosBatchSuppliedJobcard

java.lang.Object
dev.galasa.zosbatch.spi.ZosBatchSuppliedJobcard
public final class ZosBatchSuppliedJobcard extends Object
Locates and parses the JOB statement in JCL that already contains its own JOB statement, and builds the JCL to be submitted. Shared by the z/OS Batch Manager implementations so that they behave identically.

The first record of the JCL that is not blank and not a comment (//*) must be the JOB statement, //jobname JOB .... The JOB statement may be continued over more than one record. A statement is continued when the operand field ends with a comma or a quoted string is not closed. Each continuation record must start with // followed by a blank. Comment records within a continued statement are considered part of the statement.

      Parse the JOB statement from the supplied JCL. The returned instance represents the supplied JCL, and build(String) builds the JCL to be submitted from it.

    • build

      public String build(String sysaffImageId)
      Build the JCL to be submitted from the JCL that this instance was parsed from. The JCL is unchanged except that:
      • if a SYSAFF image is provided and the JCL does not already contain a /*JOBPARM record with SYSAFF=, a /*JOBPARM SYSAFF=[image] record is inserted immediately after the last record of the JOB statement
      • a line terminator is added to the end if there is not one
      Parameters:
      sysaffImageId - the image ID to use for SYSAFF, or null to not add a SYSAFF record
      Returns:
      the JCL to be submitted
